senses.gloss: authority given to a person or organization to act
senses.example: The committee received a mandate to negotiate the contract.

translations.th_TH: อำนาจที่ได้รับมอบหมาย; การมอบอำนาจ

example_translations.zh_TW: 委員會獲得了協商合約的授權。

example_translations.vi_VN: Ủy ban đã nhận được quyền đàm phán hợp đồng.

senses.example: The new policy mandates annual safety training.
